s3_15_scores_by_district.title: English and AP scores against economic status in Westchester school districts
s3_15_scores_by_district.source: New York State Education Department; economic disadvantage and Grades 3 to 8 English proficiency 2024-25, Advanced Placement scores of 3 or higher 2023-24. Five of 36 districts, each closest to an even five-step scale across the range of economic disadvantage (0, 19, 38, 57, 76), ties alphabetical; Port Chester-Rye is also at 76%, with 37.0% English proficient and 58.7% scoring 3 or higher. Across all 36, economic disadvantage tracks English proficiency at r = -0.90 and Advanced Placement at r = -0.81. AP results NYSED does not publish (fewer than five students tested) are left out, not counted as zero. District level and unweighted, not evidence of individual-level cause.
